goal: Complete all six approved chapters, publish the exact frozen candidate to the public temporary VII URL, and pass post-publication checks before asking Adir to continue.

requirements.acceptance: Adir and Roy are the only full-platform access managers; all other identities use explicit persisted grants. Owner, scoped, unauthorized, audit, save and reload states pass live.
Every undated starting-price surface takes the lower valid winter/summer supplier value through one canonical selector and handles missing, invalid, equal and zero inputs honestly.
Hebrew, English, Russian and French are complete and audience-native across public and administration routes, dynamic states, metadata and structured data, with correct direction.
Video, homepage and broad shared layout families are complete on desktop/mobile, every visible control works, and approved version 516 behavior is preserved.
PWA install/offline/update, 390x844 and low-height mobile flows, live performance targets, keyboard/focus/semantics/contrast/reduced-motion and modern Hebrew typography pass on the public artifact.

All four supplier worlds pass current Sites/D1 scheduled/manual sync, guard, failure and recovery checks; an operator alert is delivered; a consistent backup is restored and compared without data loss.
The exact clean candidate is published to the existing public temporary URL with an immutable identity, version 516 rollback and post-publication regression evidence.

requirements.statement: Restore the approved preview-card image size, crop, and effective visual resolution before publication.
requirements.acceptance_check: Direct public-vs-candidate comparison shows preview-card media geometry and source-pixel quality match the approved baseline across affected card families and mobile/desktop.
evidence: app/globals.css restores the review-card media column and gallery to 112px by 112px.
Fresh desktop and mobile public-versus-candidate screenshots in project_knowledge/release_evidence/vii-six-chapter-completion-20261020/card-media-diagnosis/ show matching media geometry.
Focused layout contracts, the 16-page strict audit, pnpm build, and all 1,345 tests pass.

operation_identity.retry_rule: Never repeat while an outcome is running, pending or uncertain. An unchanged failure receives at most one retry after a concrete discriminating change.
